disqualifier.note: Independent observations of send progress: a local subscribe latch and the live turnActiveAtom. The timeout path ORs them (any evidence the turn started), so all four combinations are legal.
Independently observed directory presence plus the operator overwrite toggle; the handler ANDs them only to decide rmdir, and missing+overwrite or exists-without-overwrite are legal.
Hardcoded HTMLVideoElement media flags at the DOM boundary; muted, loop, and playsInline are independent HTML attributes, and this call site happens to set all three true.

Independent axes: connected is the Box probe payload on the status AsyncResult; busy is the local command machine (syncing||reviewing). The trigger ANDs them as a permission guard, and mixed true/false is legal.

Two radio checked attrs projected from one profileId; combined-true cannot occur because an id cannot equal both, but the booleans are display projections of an already-single literal, not a stored union.
Independent waiting axes: busy is the panel command machine, conflicts.waiting is the conflicts query AsyncResult. Review disables on busy; retry disables on waiting.
Independent feature gates: Vite DEV and the VITE_REACT_GRAB opt-out. The if-conjunction is a permission guard over free combinations, not a masked union.
Independent Next.js route cache exports on sibling app files; each route sets instant=false for itself, and the pair is not one domain state variable.
Independent HTML required attrs on distinct form controls; name, email, and message are separate fields, and mixed required/optional is legal.
